title: Resting in the Gardener
headline: How to Stop Carrying What Belongs to God
tagline: The security of the harvest has never rested on the seed. It rests on the One tending the field.
seo_title: How to Stop Carrying What Belongs to God (John 15:1) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: The harvest never rested on the seed but on the Gardener. A devotional for men on John 15:1 about releasing outcomes and trusting God's care.
verse_text: I am the true vine, and My Father is the gardener.

scriptures.text: I am the true vine, and My Father is the gardener.
He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.…
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

items: Throughout this week we’ve talked about:
the seed,
the soil,
the waiting,
the harvest,
the seasons.
But we’ve almost overlooked the most important Person in the story.
The Gardener.
The security of the harvest has never rested on the seed.
It rests on the faithfulness of the One tending the field.
Where have I been carrying responsibility that actually belongs to God?
What outcome am I trying to control?
What would change if I truly trusted the Gardener?
Release the timeline.
Release the pressure.
Release the comparison.
Release the outcome.
Father,
Thank You that my life is not ultimately sustained by my strength but by Your care.
Teach me to trust Your hands more than my plans.
Help me rest in Your love.
Grow whatever You desire within me.
When the harvest comes, may it bring You glory.
In Jesus name, Amen.
God is faithful.
His timing is perfect.
His purposes are good.
His hands are steady.
His work in me is not finished.
I choose to trust the Gardener.
The mature believer finds peace not because he understands every season….
but because he knows the One who holds them.
